bible_verses.english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
Yahweh is high above all nations. His glory is above the heavens.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, I exalt You today above the heavens and above every detail of my life. Even when my heart feels heavy or uncertain, I choose to magnify Your holy name and acknowledge Your sovereignty over all things. Let Your glory shine brightly through me, filling my world with Your peace and goodness. May my worship honor You today and remind my heart of Your endless grace. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In the middle of life's trials and uncertainties, Psalm 57 invites us to lift our eyes above our temporary surroundings and fix them on the majestic glory of God. When we sing "Be Thou Exalted," we align our hearts with the reality that God reigns supreme over the highest heavens and all the earth. This prayerful declaration shifts our focus from our daily struggles to His unfailing love and sovereign power. As you sing today, surrender your worries and let your worship exalt Jesus above every fear.
